rationale: Preserve the read-only secondary-worktree audit, complete paths, size-descending ordering, commit age, ancestry, tracked/untracked counts, local remote-tracking state, PR records, latest scoped chat timestamp and review buckets. Replace fetch, origin/main assumption, gh query and private transcript scan with an explicit local base and optional validated user-scoped exports. Every dirty or unknown candidate is held. Age never permits disposal; CLOSED PRs do not imply merge. JSON fields use null for unavailable evidence and separate known absence from missing history/PR inputs. Python standard-library helper supplies the exact audit_worktrees API. Thirteen local fixture tests pass, including independent log and tracking-count failures held as unknown; adaptation status is a candidate for fresh source review, distinct from host behavior verification.
